answer: Each agent must stake a unique onyx token bound to a hardware beacon, and every epoch it submits a marble-pattern proof derived from that beacon's entropy. Duplicate identities collapse because the same physical beacon cannot produce two distinct marble patterns, and forging one requires acquiring and staking a second onyx at full cost, making mass sybil creation economically self-defeating. The Agent0261 deployment anchors trust at NrtLNpN9AR.
